question: 查询2024年营业收入最高的公司名称及其营收
schema: 表 revenue(company TEXT, year INT, revenue NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT company, revenue FROM revenue WHERE year = 2024 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: 统计2023年银行表中共有多少家银行
schema: 表 bank(bank_id INT, name TEXT, year INT)
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank WHERE year = 2023

question: 查询甲公司2022年的营业成本
schema: 表 cost(company TEXT, year INT, cost NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT cost FROM cost WHERE company = '甲公司' AND year = 2022

question: 列出不良贷款率超过2%的所有银行及对应年份
schema: 表 asset(bank TEXT, year INT, npl_ratio NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT bank, year FROM asset WHERE npl_ratio > 0.02

question: 查询2024年净利润为负的公司列表
schema: 表 profit(company TEXT, year INT, net_profit NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT company FROM profit WHERE year = 2024 AND net_profit < 0

question: 查询市值表中最新的记录日期
schema: 表 mktcap(code TEXT, date TEXT, mktcap NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(date) FROM mktcap

question: 统计2024年研报表中每个行业覆盖的公司数量
schema: 表 research(industry TEXT, company TEXT, year INT)
gold_sql: SELECT industry, COUNT(DISTINCT company) FROM research WHERE year = 2024 GROUP BY industry

question: 查询乙银行2024年末的总资产
schema: 表 asset(bank TEXT, year INT, total_asset NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT total_asset FROM asset WHERE bank = '乙银行' AND year = 2024

question: 计算甲公司2024年的毛利率（营业收入减营业成本后除以营业收入）
schema: 表 revenue(company TEXT, year INT, revenue NUMERIC); 表 cost(company TEXT, year INT, cost NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT (r.revenue - c.cost) / NULLIF(r.revenue, 0) AS gross_margin FROM revenue r JOIN cost c ON r.company = c.company AND r.year = c.year WHERE r.company = '甲公司' AND r.year = 2024

question: 查询2024年营收排名前五的公司及营收
schema: 表 revenue(company TEXT, year INT, revenue NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT company, revenue FROM revenue WHERE year = 2024 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: 统计每年平均不良贷款率
schema: 表 asset(bank TEXT, year INT, npl_ratio NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT year, AVG(npl_ratio) FROM asset GROUP BY year

question: 查询甲公司2023年营收同比增速（相对2022年）
schema: 表 revenue(company TEXT, year INT, revenue NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT (r1.revenue - r0.revenue) / NULLIF(r0.revenue, 0) AS yoy FROM revenue r0 JOIN revenue r1 ON r0.company = r1.company WHERE r0.company = '甲公司' AND r0.year = 2022 AND r1.year = 2023

question: 查询同时出现在2024年营收表和利润表中的公司数量
schema: 表 revenue(company TEXT, year INT, revenue NUMERIC); 表 profit(company TEXT, year INT, net_profit NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.company) FROM revenue r JOIN profit p ON r.company = p.company AND r.year = p.year WHERE r.year = 2024

question: 查询2024年每家银行的存贷比并按降序排列
schema: 表 loans(bank TEXT, year INT, deposits NUMERIC, loans NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT bank, loans / NULLIF(deposits, 0) AS ldr FROM loans WHERE year = 2024 ORDER BY ldr DESC

question: 查询2023年研报覆盖数量最多的行业
schema: 表 research(industry TEXT, company TEXT, year INT)
gold_sql: SELECT industry FROM research WHERE year = 2023 GROUP BY industry ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 查询乙银行2022至2024年间不良贷款率的最高值
schema: 表 asset(bank TEXT, year INT, npl_ratio NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(npl_ratio) FROM asset WHERE bank = '乙银行' AND year BETWEEN 2022 AND 2024

question: 查询2024年净利润大于1亿且营收大于10亿的公司
schema: 表 profit(company TEXT, year INT, net_profit NUMERIC); 表 revenue(company TEXT, year INT, revenue NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT p.company FROM profit p JOIN revenue r ON p.company = r.company AND p.year = r.year WHERE p.year = 2024 AND p.net_profit > 100000000 AND r.revenue > 1000000000

question: 统计市值表中2024年每个交易日总市值大于1000亿的股票数量
schema: 表 mktcap(code TEXT, date TEXT, mktcap NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT date, COUNT(*) FROM mktcap WHERE date LIKE '2024%' AND mktcap > 100000000000 GROUP BY date

question: 查询甲公司2021至2024年每年的营业成本及其占营收比例
schema: 表 revenue(company TEXT, year INT, revenue NUMERIC); 表 cost(company TEXT, year INT, cost NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT r.year, c.cost, c.cost / NULLIF(r.revenue, 0) AS cost_ratio FROM revenue r JOIN cost c ON r.company = c.company AND r.year = c.year WHERE r.company = '甲公司' AND r.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2024 ORDER BY r.year

question: 查询2024年资产负债率超过80%的银行数量
schema: 表 asset(bank TEXT, year INT, debt_ratio NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asset WHERE year = 2024 AND debt_ratio > 0.8

question: 计算每家公司2024年相对2023年的营收增速，并列出增速为正的公司
schema: 表 revenue(company TEXT, year INT, revenue NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT r1.company, (r1.revenue - r0.revenue) / NULLIF(r0.revenue, 0) AS yoy FROM revenue r0 JOIN revenue r1 ON r0.company = r1.company WHERE r0.year = 2023 AND r1.year = 2024 AND r1.revenue > r0.revenue

question: 查询2024年营收排名前三公司的平均毛利率
schema: 表 revenue(company TEXT, year INT, revenue NUMERIC); 表 cost(company TEXT, year INT, cost NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT AVG((r.revenue - c.cost) / NULLIF(r.revenue, 0)) AS avg_margin FROM revenue r JOIN cost c ON r.company = c.company AND r.year = c.year WHERE r.year = 2024 AND r.company IN (SELECT company FROM revenue WHERE year = 2024 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3)

question: 查询连续两年不良贷款率下降的银行
schema: 表 asset(bank TEXT, year INT, npl_ratio NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT a1.bank FROM asset a0 JOIN asset a1 ON a0.bank = a1.bank JOIN asset a2 ON a1.bank = a2.bank WHERE a0.year = 2022 AND a1.year = 2023 AND a2.year = 2024 AND a1.npl_ratio < a0.npl_ratio AND a2.npl_ratio < a1.npl_ratio

question: 查询2024年每个行业中被研报覆盖且当年净利润为正的公司比例
schema: 表 research(industry TEXT, company TEXT, year INT); 表 profit(company TEXT, year INT, net_profit NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT rs.industry, AVG(CASE WHEN p.net_profit > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS profitable_ratio FROM research rs LEFT JOIN profit p ON rs.company = p.company AND rs.year = p.year WHERE rs.year = 2024 GROUP BY rs.industry

question: 查询2024年市值占比最高的行业（按公司市值总和）
schema: 表 mktcap(code TEXT, date TEXT, mktcap NUMERIC); 表 stock_industry(code TEXT, industry TEXT)
gold_sql: SELECT si.industry FROM mktcap m JOIN stock_industry si ON m.code = si.code WHERE m.date LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY si.industry ORDER BY SUM(m.mktcap) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 查询甲公司2024年营收在全部公司中的百分位排名
schema: 表 revenue(company TEXT, year INT, revenue NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT company, revenue, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue) AS pct_rank FROM revenue WHERE year = 2024

question: 查询2024年存贷比高于行业平均的银行
schema: 表 loans(bank TEXT, year INT, deposits NUMERIC, loans NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT bank, loans / NULLIF(deposits, 0) AS ldr FROM loans WHERE year = 2024 AND loans / NULLIF(deposits, 0) > (SELECT AVG(loans / NULLIF(deposits, 0)) FROM loans WHERE year = 2024)

question: 查询2024年每个公司营收环比（相对2023）变化率的最大值对应公司
schema: 表 revenue(company TEXT, year INT, revenue NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT company, yoy FROM (SELECT r1.company, (r1.revenue - r0.revenue) / NULLIF(r0.revenue, 0) AS yoy FROM revenue r0 JOIN revenue r1 ON r0.company = r1.company WHERE r0.year = 2023 AND r1.year = 2024) ORDER BY yoy DESC LIMIT 1

question: 查询2023与2024年均被超过三家券商研报覆盖的公司
schema: 表 research(industry TEXT, company TEXT, year INT, broker TEXT)
gold_sql: SELECT company FROM research WHERE year IN (2023, 2024) GROUP BY company, year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT broker) > 3

question: 查询甲公司2024年营收占当年全部公司营收总和的比例
schema: 表 revenue(company TEXT, year INT, revenue NUMERIC)
gold_sql: SELECT r.revenue / NULLIF(SUM(t.revenue), 0) AS share FROM revenue r JOIN revenue t ON t.year = r.year WHERE r.company = '甲公司' AND r.year = 2024
